description: QEEG.com.au Clinical Symptom Checklist definition (Sections 3.1, 3.2, 4.3). The complete live HTML form and PDF generator are driven by this file: every section and field listed below is rendered from the first section to the last. Do not change a domain 'key' once reports exist.

domains.title: 1. Inattention
domains.desc: Sustained focus deficit, distractibility, carelessness, task persistence failure

domains.title: 2. Hyperactivity / Impulsivity
domains.desc: Motor restlessness, impulse delay failure, verbal interruption, psychomotor agitation

domains.title: 3. Anxiety
domains.desc: Generalized worry, autonomic hyperarousal, panic episodes, somatic muscle tension

domains.title: 4. Mood / Depression
domains.desc: Persistent low mood, anhedonia, emotional lability, motivational withdrawal

domains.title: 5. Rumination
domains.desc: Repetitive negative thinking, cognitive hyper-fixation, perseveration, intrusive thoughts

domains.title: 6. Emotional Regulation
domains.desc: Affective volatility, low frustration tolerance, explosive dysregulation, mood reactivity

domains.title: 7. Sleep Difficulties
domains.desc: Sleep onset latency > 45m, frequent nocturnal waking, non-restorative sleep, diurnal fatigue

domains.title: 8. Executive Function / Organisation
domains.desc: Working memory deficit, mental flexibility, sequencing slowing, planning friction

domains.title: 9. Oppositional / Behavioural Difficulties
domains.desc: Defiance, rule-testing, reactivity, behavioral impulse control deficit, conduct friction

domains.title: 10. Social Difficulties
domains.desc: Pragmatic language friction, social cue interpretation delay, interpersonal withdrawal

domains.title: 11. Sensory Processing
domains.desc: Auditory / visual / tactile hypersensitivity, photophobia, sensory overload gating delay

sections.title: 2. Case Reference & Client Demographics (zero-PII policy)
sections.insight: Do NOT enter patient full names or birthdates. Use Case Reference and Age/Gender metrics only.

fields.label: Client Cooperation & Protocol Compliance
fields.detail: Client maintained quiet wakefulness during recording.

fields.label: Artifact Control & Filter
fields.detail: Ocular blinks, EMG muscle tension removed; Test/Retest reliability >= 0.80.

sections.title: 7. Clinical Decision Support & Automated Synthesis Notice
lines: • QEEG.com.au correlation reports are automated, evidence-linked literature synthesis documents mapping QEEG spectral power deviations against peer-reviewed neuroimaging literature.
• These reports DO NOT constitute human-reviewed medical advice, psychiatric diagnosis, or treatment prescriptions.
• The referring practitioner retains sole clinical responsibility for patient assessment, protocol selection, and medical diagnostic decisions under Australian healthcare regulations.
